title: Find a simple closed quasigeodesic in polynomial time
formal: Is there a polynomial-time algorithm that constructs a simple closed quasigeodesic on every convex polyhedron?
context:
A full card must specify numeric input and output representations. The archived TCS-6061 source asks for any finite algorithm for a simple loop; polynomial running time is a distinct requirement. Self-intersecting or merely weakly simple loops do not automatically qualify.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Would turn a classical geometric existence theorem into an efficient constructive procedure.
